title: Existing abelian sheafification is left exact from locally bijective units
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with object universe u and arrow universe v. Suppose the inclusion of sheaves of abelian groups with values in universe w into presheaves admits a left adjoint [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and the maps inverted by this left adjoint are exactly the locally injective and locally surjective maps. Then that left adjoint preserves finite limits. No size relation among u, v, w is required.

source.place: Tag 00WJ, exactness of sheafification; Tag 03CN, proof of assertion (1) for abelian presheaves. The finite-refinement argument adapts these proofs to an already existing reflector in an arbitrary section universe.

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-locally-bijective-finite-limit to the natural transformation from a finite presheaf diagram to its componentwise sheafification. Its components are locally bijective by WEqualsLocallyBijective and W_toSheafify. The induced limit map therefore belongs to J.W and its sheafification is an isomorphism.

The limit of the sheafified diagram is a sheaf (Mathlib Sheaf.isSheaf_of_isLimit). Its sheafification unit is an isomorphism. Prove by sheafify_hom_ext and limit.hom_ext that the canonical endofunctor limit comparison is sheafifyMap of the preceding limit map followed by the inverse unit on its target. This comparison is thus an isomorphism, so preservesLimit_of_isIso_post gives preservation of each finite limit. Reflect limits along the fully faithful sheaf inclusion using preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves, then apply HasSheafify.mk'. The empty diagram is included by the same argument.

proof_origin.description: V3: complete Lean proof following the finite local-refinement plan of Stacks 00WJ and 03CN. The local-bijectivity stability lemma is also fully proved; no new holes and no site-size assumption.
